title: Gate Guard
story: The temple gate only opens for scores of 50 or more. Everyone else is asked to try again.
goal: Read a score. Print Pass if it is 50 or more, otherwise print Try again.
starter:
score = int(input())
# print Pass if the score is 50 or more, otherwise Try again
hints: A decision has the shape: if condition: (indented action) else: (indented action).
The condition for passing is score >= 50. Remember the colons and the indentation.
socratic: What two symbols must end the if line and the else line?
What happens to the lines under if when the condition is false?
explain: In one sentence: when does the else part run?
alt:
score = int(input())
print("Pass" if score >= 50 else "Try again")

example.title: Worked example: pass or fail
example.note: if checks a condition; else covers everything else. The body is indented.
